prompt:
This is a bounded LTZZZ-owned public task under original task DEEP-SUPERAGENT-20261103. Context: the owner asked the Deep coordinator to intake the team work board and say what can actually advance. The real board lives in an external tracker. You have no network access and must NOT claim you read it. You are given only a sanitized structural sample of nine board items.

Sample items, each with: key, state_type (backlog|unstarted|started|completed), priority (0=none,1=urgent,2=high,3=normal,4=low), age_days, has_recent_comment, blocked_flag.
I01 started, priority 1, age 21, comment true, blocked false.
I02 started, priority 2, age 24, comment true, blocked true.
I03 started, priority 2, age 12, comment false, blocked false.
I04 backlog, priority 4, age 5, comment true, blocked false.
I05 unstarted, priority 0, age 30, comment false, blocked false.
I06 unstarted, priority 0, age 18, comment false, blocked false.
I07 completed, priority 2, age 26, comment true, blocked false.
I08 unstarted, priority 0, age 9, comment false, blocked false.
I09 unstarted, priority 0, age 2, comment false, blocked false.

Task: produce a deterministic advancement disposition for each of the nine items. Every item gets exactly one code from this fixed set: advance_now, needs_owner_decision, needs_evidence, stale_close, keep_backlog. Then name the single item that should move first and the rule that decided it.

Rules you must apply in this order and must state:
1. a board state label is not proof of work performed.
2. a started item with blocked_flag true must be needs_owner_decision, never advance_now.
3. an unstarted item with priority 0 and age over 14 days must be keep_backlog or stale_close, never advance_now.
4. a completed item must not be re-opened by you.
5. only started or unstarted items with blocked_flag false may be advance_now.

Also state which dispositions require a human decision seat rather than coordinator authority, and explicitly record that reading or analysing a board never authorises writing status, posting comments, or closing any item.

Return concise JSON only: items (key, disposition, rule_id), first_to_move, human_decision_keys, write_authority_statement, and a one-line limit note. Do not claim any real board was read, any item advanced, or any write performed. Fictional sample only. Preserve task and package IDs. Do not repeat a provider request after an unknown result.
